question.text: A uniform solid cylinder of length $L$ and radius $R$ has moment of inertia about its axis equal to $I_{1}$. A small co-centric cylinder of length $L / 2$ and radius $R / 3$ carved from this cylinder has moment of inertia about its axis equals to $I_{2}$. The ratio $I_{1} / I_{2}$ is $\_\_\_\_$.
